changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names and model names to standard forms. Consolidated COMET variants. Simplified model descriptions while keeping key architectures. Added missing languages and BERTScore model.

Simplified metric variants to base forms as per guidelines. Removed ASR prefixes since they're implementation details, not separate metrics. Consolidated BLASER supervised/unsupervised variants into base BLASER.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper focuses on traditional automatic metrics and human evaluation.

guideline: Rate semantic similarity between audio pair on 5-point Likert scale
Ignore minor errors that do not affect understanding

changes_made.explanation: Normalized the guideline descriptions and extracted explicit criteria of coherence and semantic similarity from the human evaluation instructions.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on speech-to-speech translation evaluation using both unsupervised and supervised variants of BLASER metric. Human evaluations were conducted by qualified bilingual annotators rating semantic similarity on a 5-point scale. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization of metric variants and consolidation of model descriptions.
